title: Release 50
summary: Owners sign their agreement before any car comes over, card payments move to a new Canadian card processor with e-Transfer whenever cards are off, field expenses say whose money paid, and every car is shown in one studio look whose renders now actually finish.

items: Owners sign their agreement with CarmaCars before any car is handed over, guided step by step in their portal
A car is approved, delivered or rented only once its owner has signed for it
Long rentals show what each owner statement carried, and signed forms show the CarmaCars countersignature in its place

Owner onboarding is one guided pipeline per car: application, terms, agreements, documents, the ownership transfer, the new registration, the fleet policy, inspection and listing, with one next step at a time

**Self-healing**: the site finds its own problems (site checks, errors, Search Console, scheduled jobs, stuck emails and texts, the server), applies the matching fix from its fix library, checks it worked and tells the Admins once only when it cannot fix it safely; Admins save what fixed a problem as a new fix in Site health > Self-healing

Booking pages and other staff and Admin pages show every date and time in Toronto time on the server and in the browser alike, so they load without the "page error" flash; booking changes read the times as Toronto time from any browser; the Admin home loads its site health again; a staff or renter policy expiry that is not a real date is said before the upload instead of failing it
The weekly townhall's Platform updates slide lists the week's releases and the staff bug reports fixed that week, each with its reporter named as a shout-out, and the count of bugs still open

Admins add and replace the business documents investors see under Investors > Documents (business plan, financial forecast, pitch deck, feature decks, or a new section); every version is kept and investors are told
Staff see what each owner still has to sign and send a reminder in one tap
A rental whose pickup was not recorded keeps its car off new offers until it is recorded
Field staff choose **Whose money?** on every expense: **My own money (pay me back)** or **Company card/cash**. My shifts shows what is **Owed to you**.
Finance is told of each expense, approves or declines it with the reason (the person is told), and pays back what is owed from **Reimbursements owed** on Payroll and Field spending.
Studio photos are made again across the fleet: a photo step that keeps failing is flagged with its reason after three tries instead of blocking every other car
Imported photos the sorter could not read are sorted again by themselves, so a car's outside photos become its cover
A studio grid shows every car's nine views side by side, so a photo that does not match the others is easy to spot

The Academy shows pictures in every section: real screens with numbered pins, good and bad example photos, flow diagrams and do and do not pairs; and about one quiz question in three has a funny wrong answer written for that very question

**Guide me** in every staff portal: an optional coach that walks you through a real job step by step while you do it, on the live screens (send an offer, answer a request, record a payment, a pickup, a return and deposit review, approve an owner's car, a field expense)

**Check-in visits**: long rentals get a free monthly check-in visit; staff work one queue (booked, due, overdue, done) and a short checklist with photos, the odometer, damage, tires, fluids and warning lights. What needs looking after becomes a To do, damage goes to the Admins, and the reading feeds the car's maintenance
Our location is now 1940 Eglinton Ave E, Toronto, ON M1L 4R1, on the site, in search results and for delivery distances
The earnings calculator now counts the car's year: cars of about the same year when we have them, otherwise the model's average moved for an older or newer car
In the CarmaCars app and the site added to a home screen, drag down from the top of any page to refresh it
The discount game now shows to signed-in people too: a renter taps once and the code goes to their account (staff see a preview and get no code)

Every page follows the owner's design rules with no exceptions: every move 300 ms or less with the kit's eases, soft see-through borders, big enough buttons and fields on phones, and copy buttons whose icon turns into a check

Every car is shown the same way: nine studio views in one room, the same size and angle for every car, on the car page, the cards, the home page and the feeds; a car still being photographed shows one "Photos coming soon" studio photo
Booking and paying keep working when card payments are off: renters pay by Interac e-Transfer instead
Renters choose **Book instantly** (pay now, confirmed) or **Request to book** (no charge until we approve) on the car page and in the booking form

title: Release 49
summary: Gift cards and gifted rentals, a Finance dashboard with every bank line matched, automatic checks that every event has its message and the guides match the app, and overdue and late-return notices.

items: A Finance dashboard: the cash in the bank and with the card processor, money in and out, HST, what renters and insurers owe, and every bank line from the bank's download matched to its payout, payment or expense
Sales are told when a website request has had no reply for 30 minutes, and the Admins at 2 hours
Finance gets a daily list of overdue renter balances with booking links, a To do for the Admins per balance overdue 3 days, and a notice for every refund paid or failed
A booking's documents list no longer shows documents that were removed or replaced, so none opens an error page
An automatic check on every change makes sure each event reaches every portal it touches, with its email template in place
The user guides and the academy are checked against the app on every change: a page, button or setting that no longer exists fails the build
An installable Android test build can be made on demand, without any store

title: Release 45
summary: Every car's listing photos are made again by Gemini from the originals, in the CarmaCars showroom with every plate blurred, every angle present and the front exterior first. Booking requests fill themselves from the renter's profile, a changed booking can be put back to an earlier version, field shifts open by themselves, staff agreements can be redone and a townhall that did not happen counts nobody absent.

items: A changed booking can be put back to any earlier version after a preview, without touching a payment
Offers and rentals entered by staff show the renter's licence, address and drivers already on file
Field shifts open by themselves ahead, with a shift for every handover and return
A townhall that did not happen no longer counts anyone absent
Staff agreements can be redone with the current terms, keeping the signed one on file
Every listing photo is made by Gemini from the original photo: outside photos stand in the CarmaCars showroom with nothing of the place they were taken in, inside photos are clean and sharp
Every licence plate is blurred so no character can be read, and no text appears anywhere else on a photo

Every car shows the full set of angles: front three-quarter, front, side profile, rear three-quarter, rear, dashboard, front seats, rear seats and trunk, the ones never photographed generated from the car's own photos
The front three-quarter is always the first photo, then the other outside photos, then the inside ones
A second check refuses any photo with the old background, a warped car, another colour or model, missing or added parts, or text, and such a photo never goes on the site

title: Release 46
summary: An Admin can show one lead's full phone number to one salesperson and hide it again; pop-ups and the top row fit a phone; four pages are sturdier; the Canada agreements To do leaves out test accounts.

items: An Admin shows a lead's full phone number to its salesperson, lead by lead, and hides it again; every other lead stays hidden
Sales asks for a lead's number in one tap, and the request reaches an Admin as a To do
The To do to send staff in Canada a new agreement leaves out test accounts

Four pages made sturdier: a time written the same by the server and every browser, a leads page that still opens when one of its lists cannot load, the pay page under the browser's own translation, and a page left open across an update that reloads by itself
Every pop-up and the portals' top row fit a phone at 375 and 320 pixels wide, checked by a test

title: Release 47
summary: A car's own photos stay on the site while their new versions are made, and the first outside photo always leads.

items: On a phone, the menu opened partway down a page keeps the header (logo and Close) at the top
The cars list for chosen dates loads again: each car is priced once, about seven times faster, and a busy moment is retried quietly
A car's own photos stay on the site while their new Gemini versions are made; one that is refused stays as it was and is flagged
The first outside photo leads the gallery and the cards wherever it sits, so no car shows a drawn sample while it has photos
The cars that rent least come first in the fleet, with a partner's fleet after our own cars
Every car shows nine views generated from its own photos in a photorealistic showroom, the front three-quarter first; a view that fails the check leaves the car's real photo in its place
Website error alerts count only real errors, once a page a day with how many people met it; dropped connections, stale tabs and browser translation are kept on record without an alert
Pages no longer fail when the browser translates them, or when a busy moment delays a page's title

title: Release 48
summary: A car can go out with the deposit still owed, signing and card names never wrongly block a renter, pay links ask only for what is owed, offers are edited in place and hold the car on time, messages go out at once, long rentals can be paid weekly, calls through the site open the caller pop-up, Rewards emails renters, every car is photographed the same way in one scene, and a payment plan's first payment confirms the booking.

items: The card box always shows on Sign and pay (phone wallets too); the licence and coverage documents are checked before pickup, not before paying
The booking page says when the deposit is still owed and how to place it
Signing no longer says "your signature does not match": the signature you drew is the one recorded, even if you press Sign quickly or sign on two devices
Coming back? Initial all the key terms and sign with your saved signature, one tap each
The details form is filled in with what you gave us last time: check it and save
A card in your name written a little differently (a middle name, a short first name, accents) no longer stops your booking
A renter's checklist says exactly which page of their own policy is still missing, and its button opens that upload, with example pictures of a pink slip and an OPCF 27 page
A pay link asks only for what is owed: after a change, the difference; a link no longer needed is cancelled by itself and never charged
CarmaCars Rewards emails renters: welcome, points earned, a new tier, the free day, reminders before points end, a monthly statement, and nudges they can unsubscribe from

From Platinum up, a rental near the renter's birthday or on a holiday weekend is 10% (Platinum) or 20% (Black) off the rental charge, shown as its own line; Gold is off until an Admin gives it a percent

A native CarmaCars app for iPhone and Android is built and waits for the company's developer accounts: find a car, ask for it, sign the agreement, pay, take the licence photos and selfie with the camera, check in and check out at the car, extend, messages and phone alerts

When the car's Tracker records speeding, harsh driving, the car outside Ontario or at an impound lot, the renter is told at once, in calm words: what happened, the charge and the clause of the agreement
A card tapped on a phone outside the booking screens can be found from Claude and recorded on its booking, with nothing charged again

An accepted offer holds the car until the offer's own expiry (and 2 hours after a same-day pickup); Renter approved by phone works with the licence photos on file; phone alerts no longer switch themselves off

A car can go out with the deposit still owed, with the reason: every booking page shows **Deposit pending**, the saved card is tried each morning and the renter is sent the deposit link; after 48 hours an Admin gets a To do
Each message type that can go by text shows its texts of the last 30 days and its channel; once email is ready for production, only urgent messages keep their texts and the rest go by email
**Approve all (n)** counts only what it can approve, and the get-ready line says which page the renter still has to send
Open pay links that asked for more than is owed were cancelled at release; Claude's connector can cancel one pay link (an Admin, previewed first, no money moves)
The offer screen is one clear form with one main button, and an offer that is out is changed in place: what staff save stays saved
The fleet calendar is easier to read on a computer and a phone: full car names, the renter and booking number on each bar, clear colours by status and today marked
Every car on the fleet calendar says whether it is free now, taken days are tinted so white is free, and **Only cars free for these dates** shows the cars you can offer

Every alert opens the exact thing it is about: the booking's messages, the conversation, the visitor, the field job or shift on the board, the person's Academy page; end of day alerts open that role's To do list

An offer is open 12 hours and closes 1 hour before the pickup at the latest; once accepted, the car is held 2 hours for the payment, then freed, and the renter gets a fresh link to pay while the car is still free
Texts and emails go out within a second or two of being queued, whoever queued them; the To do lists, Today, Alerts and the booking lists update by themselves
A booking can be a long-term rental paid weekly: the car stays out on the calendar until the renter gives notice, and each weekly payment moves the return 7 days
The academy teaches the guides: worked examples for every role, and the path The renter's side for every staff member

Calls through the site open the caller pop-up and its Call helper within a second, for the calls you place and the ones that ring you; every call keeps its recording, transcript and summary on the renter
A booking on a weekly, every 2 weeks or monthly plan is confirmed once its first payment is paid, and a plan never shows an empty last payment
A booking partly paid but not yet confirmed can move to another car, or other dates, with **Edit**; its price and its payments stay

A payment of the whole total pays every line of the booking (rental, short notice, young driver fee, Protection Plan) and confirms the booking when nothing is open; bookings stuck that way were repaired

A deposit by e-Transfer or cash is twice the car's deposit (Program settings); record a part, a top-up or more than the deposit (given back with it), shown as **under, still owed** or **over, to return**

Changing the deposit updates the Money tab and **Collect $X deposit** at once, also while the booking waits for payment; a voided deposit is **Not collected** again everywhere and can be recorded again

Tips: record a cash or e-Transfer tip on the Money tab; half to the salesperson, half to the staff member at the handover (CarmaCars keeps the half with no staff member); your tips on **My sales** and **My pay**; every tip on **Money > Tips**
**Approve** on Documents names what it approves; one driver reads **No additional drivers**; **Licence and selfie verified** ticks as soon as every image is approved
Every greyed-out button says what to do first
The field Ready check reads **No additional drivers** for one driver, the Returned text carries the tip link, and the greyed-out button hints name the specific thing to do

A text that cannot go (the texting service out of credits, or any refusal) is emailed instead and marked "not sent: fell back to email"; Admins get one alert a day, not one per text, and no text is ever sent late when credits come back
Phone alerts stay on unless you turn them off yourself; if your device needs permission again, the portal says so with one button
All work communication happens in the group work chats, never in private messages (a new academy lesson and a rule in the guides)
Staff access is suspended after 5 days in a row without using the portal; the email has a link to ask for it back
**Settings > Calls > Run test call** checks every step of a call from the browser and names the failing one with what to press
Amazon SES still in its sandbox, or the texting service out of credits, raises one Admin alert a day with the exact step
A suspended staff member's request for access back arrives as one alert; **Unlock** on Staff restores them

In the new phone app, field staff run their day (jobs, shifts, the handover checklist with the phone's camera, clocking in and out with the phone's location), Sales work their leads with calls and texts through the platform and numbers still masked, and owners see their cars, bookings and statements

Tracker events (off until the trackers are installed): one alert per car, kind and 30 minutes with an evidence record (map point, speed, time, source, a seal), **Charge** on a speeding record with the evidence attached, and pound flags when a car is parked at a known impound lot
Words are no longer squeezed into slivers or broken letter by letter on a phone: labels, car names, buttons and notes keep their room, and a wide table scrolls instead of crushing its columns
Form labels such as "Where you are (city or neighbourhood)" fit a small phone

Every car's photos look taken in one studio: the same nine views, the same angle and framing, the covers all facing the same way, in the dark dealership with the CarmaCars sign (the model's name behind the car on the first photo)
A view a car has no photo of is made from its other photos; a car with no photo at all gets its outside views from its model's stock photo, in its own colour
The home page, the cards, the car page, partner feeds and the sitemap show the same photos, the front three-quarter first
Where the site showed a sample photo (the home page's big photo, example cars and cars without photos yet), real cars of the same type now show in turn, all in the same studio angle
The home page's big photo and the photo sections show real fleet cars, cut out and standing exactly where the sample car stood, over the section's own background; the home page shows them in turn
A car with no front plate gets no blur or box on its front bumper; the studio photos have the plate taken off cleanly, and where a blur is still used it covers only the plate, with a soft edge

The GPS tracker and kill switch has a product page with its prices, a comparison table and a waitlist, a page for each way people search for it (kill switch, starter interrupt, rental car tracker, anti-theft, fleet tracking, hosts, tolls and tickets) and install pages for Ontario cities
Search pages are built from blocks that read fast: the short answer, the cars, price cards, the detail under headings that open on a tap, questions, and on a phone one button that stays within reach

Every search page shows the other services with their prices: the tracker, listing your car, the chauffeur, delivery, coverage, monthly rentals, replacement cars, rideshare, young drivers and the add-ons; one new page lists every service
New pages for renting to drive for Uber or Lyft, renting with a G2 licence, and a car with a phone charger, flowers or a child seat waiting in it
A visitor who follows a search result or an AI answer to a place or vehicle page gets the page at once, and the website answers search engines on one address only
The car page shows the weekly rate, the 30-day rate and the deposit under the daily rate, with a button straight to the request

Every car is rendered in the full studio set from its own photos, and its first photo is a clean side profile, the nose the same way on every car; the front three-quarter is second, then the rest, then the car's real photos on the same branded background. The car page says **Rendered photos** above the gallery, with **See its real photos**
On a car card, a car with its cut-out drives off the side of its frame when you point at it (on a phone, once when it comes into view), then eases back in; with reduced motion it stays still
The home page draws the CarmaCars logo along its lines, then fills it in (once a visit)

Buttons press and spring back, cards lift, tabs slide, toasts slide in, saves show a tick, dashboard figures count up and new list items rise in, on the site and in every portal; **Pause animations** in the footer stops all motion
Fields no longer zoom on phones, rails fade at their edges, menus open from where you tapped, and a request sent or a booking confirmed gets a small burst
The Cars filter lists one model per family (CLA-Class, 3 Series) with its number of cars; the trim is shown on the car. Makes, trims and body names are written one way everywhere

Every tap answers at once: a red bar runs along the top and the page you opened shows its outline straight away while it loads, in every portal and on the website, instead of the old page sitting still
Portal pages show their frame and outline first and fill in as their information arrives; the Owner home and the Admin and staff menus load their parts together instead of one after another
Buttons that save something show they are working until it is done
The website now runs on CarmaCars' own server in Canada, behind the same protection and speed layer as before

Every AI feature (chat replies, the staff assistant, listing copy, photo and plate checks, call and interview transcripts) keeps working at no cost: when the daily free AI allowance is used, models on CarmaCars' own server answer, and identity documents and recordings never leave it
The photo queue no longer stalls on steps waiting with no end

The app signs in with email, a texted code or a passkey, can lock itself behind the phone's face or fingerprint check, and does only what the same account may do on the website; an account can be deleted from inside the app
Staff can start the render backfill (every published car) and read its progress; image spend stays under the daily limits
Owners get an email and an alert when their car's studio photos are live; Fleet gets them in the next digest to look over
The tracker ingest takes each signed request once (a replay is refused), limits requests a minute, and stops answering a sender that keeps failing the signature

title: Release 44
summary: Staff make and take calls in the browser from anywhere, Sales sees which cars are free for any dates, every car's listing photos are made to one Gemini standard with the front exterior first, and owner statements count a cancellation only for what it kept.

items: Telling us the car is back, and sending photos of a problem, now work from a phone browser opened by a text message link
A cancelled or no-show booking is on the owner's statement only for the charge actually kept: nothing paid, no line
Owners see every rental their cars have been on, oldest or newest first, with their earnings for each as their statements count them
Staff make and take calls in the browser of the staff and Admin portals on the business number, from anywhere, without using their own phone number
A call to the business number rings the staff who are online by role, and a call nobody answers becomes a missed call with its follow-up task
The calendar shows, for any pickup and return, which cars are available, why the others are not and when they are free next, with one click to an offer for those dates
The AI interview decides by itself again by default, and new hires are welcomed with their training, shift claiming and the team chat
A booking's total and balance follow every change of a line, and an Admin can set a total directly
Paperwork for insurer-billed rentals matches the insurer's own numbers exactly, and an ended rental can be signed for the file
Payment records show only money actually received, and a new data check lists any booking where they disagree
The automatic answers wait while a person is talking with the customer, also in the live chat
Field staff can add the photos and readings of past check-ins and check-outs, from a list of the ones still missing

Every outside photo has the same CarmaCars showroom behind it: when a car cannot be cut out cleanly, Gemini replaces the background from the original photo instead of leaving the place it was taken in
The plate is only ever on the car's plate: no plate text on the wall sign, the model name or anywhere else on the photo
Inside photos are sharp across the whole cabin, never blurred; the blurred ones are made again
The first photo of every car is its outside front three-quarter: outside photos filed as details are found and moved, so Redo photos with Gemini no longer answers that there is nothing to redo
Redo every car with Gemini brings the whole fleet to the current photo standard, and the rest follows by itself within Gemini's daily allowance
Every request from the phone service is checked against its signature before anything is done
A person who works in Sales only can read only their own leads

title: Release 39
summary: Listing photos in real photographed showroom rooms (or the real photo when the cut-out is not clean), and a self-check of the live site after every deploy.

items: Outside listing photos stand in a real photographed dealership room when one is stored: the car about 70% of the width, its wheels on the floor, a soft contact shadow and a faint reflection, its light matched to the room; no sign or lettering on a real wall

The rooms are real photos licensed for commercial use (CC0, public domain or CC BY), fetched once from Wikimedia Commons with their author, licence and source kept; until one is stored the drawn showroom stays
A cut-out that is not clean enough (pieces, a blurry or ragged edge) is never placed in a room: the real photo is used, its plate covered as usual, and the photo says why
Program settings > Listings: the photographed rooms switch (on), the car's width in the room (0.70) and the cut-out quality floor (0.60)

After every deploy the site checks itself: a key page or the sign-in page failing (5xx, Error 1101) fails the deploy; listed cars on the stand-in while they have a real photo, stand-in lettering that overflows, covers made from a poor cut-out, empty sitemaps and pages wrongly marked noindex send the Admins an alert (Site self-check) and are kept as a report

title: Release 40
summary: Search pages kept to Ontario, cars from 2005 and newer, and one page per service with its other names listed on it.

items: Welcome tells a new staff member what their agreement is waiting for (home address, driver's licence number) with a link to each place, what only CarmaCars can set, and that it arrives within about 5 minutes once the profile is complete; filling in a missing value now makes the agreement at the next run instead of the next day
Every form on the website, when it cannot be sent, lists what is missing or wrong near the send button, outlines each such field in red with a short message and moves the cursor to the first one

Sales calls and texts every lead and request through the site again while customer numbers stay hidden; the first call asks for the salesperson's own mobile once and saves it without a texted code, and a call that cannot start says what to do
Settings > Search: Ontario is the only region on; any region can be switched back on, and the place pages, sitemaps and the list of provinces follow at once
Settings > Vehicle pages: the oldest model year with pages (2005), a setting

The other names of a service send visitors to the service's page with a permanent redirect and are in no sitemap; different services (interior and exterior detailing, ceramic coating, window tint, PPF, financing, leasing, lease takeover, the replacement rental while a car is repaired, each mechanical service) keep their own pages
Pages of the regions that are off and of older model years are answered at the edge, before the site renders anything

The place pages cover Ontario only: every city, town and neighbourhood in Ontario keeps its pages; the other provinces, the United States and Mexico are switched off (kept, not deleted) and answer not found

The pages of a whole province, territory or country that is off (Quebec, British Columbia, the United States, Mexico ...) answer not found and leave the /car-rental hub; the Canada page says we operate in Ontario
Vehicle pages cover model years from 2005 on; older years have no page and are in no sitemap or list of years

One page per service in each place and for each make, model and year: car hire, cars for hire and vehicle rental lead to the car rental page, auto body repair to collision repair, auto detailing to car detailing; each page lists the other names it is searched by ("Also searched as: ...")

title: Release 41
summary: Every portal updates by itself, marketing emails go to everyone who gave us their email with one-click unsubscribe, and protection is changed in one step by staff and renters.

items: A trip's status, payment, agreement and checklist update on the page by themselves
A weekly email with the cars ready to rent and the deals running, and an email each time a new car joins the fleet
One click unsubscribes from every marketing email, at once; booking, payment and safety emails always go
The privacy policy (updated November 12, 2026) says who gets marketing emails, why (CASL implied consent), who sends them and how to unsubscribe

Renters change their own protection on their booking page: the Protection Plan at once, their own policy or card coverage before pickup, and leaving the Protection Plan after our team checks their proof

Credit card coverage is chosen only with a card from our list that covers the car and a promise to pay with it; otherwise the renter's own auto policy with a promise to upload the policy; otherwise the Protection Plan
No more "send me deals" box on the booking request, the car pages or the discount game
The owner's dashboard, bookings and money update by themselves

Owners are no longer emailed when a booking comes in, since many bookings are cancelled: they are emailed when a trip is complete and the car is back (dates, distance driven and their share), and every Monday with a summary of last week's trips, the next 14 days and the month so far
Bookings, a booking's page, requests and offers, leads, messages, the calendar, Today, field jobs and shifts show changes made elsewhere within about two seconds, without a reload
The alerts bell and its pop-up react as soon as an alert arrives
What someone is typing is kept: an update waits until they leave the field
Marketing > Email campaigns: the audience, what is waiting, queued and sent, who unsubscribed, and each campaign; Sales sees it read only

Lists show the newest first, in the order they came in: bookings, hiring applications, leads (Sort still offers Priority and Oldest), investors and every other list; queues ordered by urgency or time stay as they are
Each campaign has its own switch and timing; marketing email volume rises automatically to the free capacity left after booking emails, never on a paid plan
Staff change how damage to the car is covered with one button on the booking: the three options with their prices, a required reason, and the new price applied at once without moving money by itself

Every listing photo has its licence plate checked automatically: a plate found is covered, a photo with no plate is marked "No plate visible", and a photo the check is not sure of is left for staff, each with one-click undo
"Cover the plate" opens the editor right under its photo and saves the CARMA plate again
Photos already on file are checked the same way, within the day's free AI allowance
Townhall reminders to every staff member and Admin: the day before, the morning of, an hour before and 15 minutes before with the join link
A townhall card on every portal home from the day before: the time, a countdown, Join / check in, Add to calendar, and a warning after a missed townhall
Interview call reminders for Admins (the morning of, an hour before the first call, 10 minutes before each) and Interviews today on Admin Today
AI interviews decide by themselves at a higher bar: a pass is hired into the academy (field: invited to a live call), a fail gets the decline or Sales email once; only a booked live call is a To-do
A harder AI interview: reliability, a typed customer message, an objection for Sales, and more probing follow-ups

Live updates read a tiny version number straight from the database while a tab is open and visible, and nothing while it is hidden; a faster push channel switches on when the server's live service is enabled
Emails can go through Amazon SES first, a high-volume sender in Canada, with the existing senders taking over on their own when it cannot send
Booking and system emails keep a free backup sender for when the main one cannot send, and marketing emails use a free sender only, so no email goes through a paid plan beyond the main sender

title: Release 42
summary: Addresses that bounce or complain are never emailed again, the faster live channel switches on, owners hear about a booking the moment it starts counting toward their revenue, and a rental covered by a credit card must be paid with that card's network.

items: When a rental is covered by the renter's credit card, the pay page says "Pay with the card that covers this rental" with the card's network, and stops a card of another network before it is charged
A request to book that cannot be sent now says exactly what to change, beside the field, and keeps everything typed
An add-on that cannot be added online no longer stops the request: staff confirm it in the offer

The owner and admin guides now say which bookings an owner statement carries: bookings paid by the renter always, and not a booking billed to an insurer that is hidden from the owner or that does not block the calendar
A booking that starts counting later reaches the owner with the new booking email
A deposit hold on a card now lasts about 30 days on Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover cards (about 7 days on other cards), so fewer holds need to be placed again during a rental

When a booking that was left out of the owner's revenue starts counting (it blocks the calendar, is shown to the owner or is billed to the renter), the owner gets the new booking email once, at that moment, never twice
Admins see **Requests that did not go through** on All leads: how many, the reasons, and each person with the car and dates
Sales gets a To-do for every request to book that was refused or failed, once per person, car and day; it closes by itself when the request arrives

The site reads its own search figures every day once an Admin connects the search console with one button: clicks, impressions and average position for the last 28 days, and the searches behind each page
A landing page or a guide that ranks just under the first results, or is shown often and rarely clicked, is written again by itself with the searches people used, a few pages a day
